description:
Convective Capital is a venture fund focused on investing in technology aimed at enhancing resilience against climate-driven disasters. The Marketing Associate will be responsible for managing content and communications, supporting events, and engaging with the Updraft network to drive growth and maintain relationships in the climate resilience sector.

Own our presence across X/Twitter, LinkedIn, and Instagram for Convective, Disasterproof and the Red Sky Summit

Repurpose podcast and event content into short-form clips, quote cards, and social copy

Write and edit episode show notes, newsletters, blog posts, and LinkedIn articles

Develop and execute a content calendar that keeps our channels active and consistent

Research and source potential Disasterproof guests across founder, science, policy, and operator communities

Manage guest outreach and booking logistics from first contact through recording

Coordinate episode assets — titles, descriptions, thumbnails — across platforms

Drive episode promotion from launch through ongoing distribution

Support planning and execution of Convective events including the Red Sky Summit, including logistics, promotion, and on-site coordination

Draft invitations, run-of-show materials, and post-event recaps

Help maintain and update the Updraft member database — keeping contacts, profiles, and tags current

Support outreach to grow and engage the network

Assist with Updraft communications including newsletters and updates

Track performance across podcast platforms (Spotify, Apple, YouTube), social channels, and email

Compile regular performance snapshots and surface growth opportunities

Use data to inform what's working and recommend what to do more of
